<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Disable HA on both nodes, immediately.

Persists ``enabled: false``, winds coordination down here, and emits
HA_DISABLED. The peer converges within one watcher tick.

The node that held the lease keeps serving as a standalone Grid; the other
parks with its Runtime, archiver fleet and notifications stopped. That is
not a preference — two nodes running integrations against the same Kafka
topics is the duplicate-production failure HA prevents, so exactly one
carries on, chosen by who held the lease. Disabling is always allowed,
unlike enabling.
